title: Ruuhu Ko woni caggal Idol
intro: E nder 6uu6ol 6uu6ol mawngol e njiimaandi, oo cfoo 6uu6ol sirlu ina fadi e nder ladde. Nde hooreejo leñol cuɓaaɗo ummii e dow tulde ceniinde ngam jokkondirde e Alla, jarribo mawngo jippii e heddiiɓe ɓee. Oo neɗɗo nanngii sahaa oo ngam waylude ngonka renndo ngoo fof. Nde gardiiɗo oo arti e goonga, jukkungo keeriiɗo, duumotooɗo, yamiraa. Mbele aɗa waawi humpitaade hol ko ooɗoo ruuhu luulndiiɗo e fenaande wonnoo?
clues: Miɗo yahda e leñol ngol rimɗinaa e juuɗe tooñooɓe doole e maandeeji kaawisaaji.
Nde hooreejo maɓɓe yahi dow hoosere ngam heɓugo ardungal, mi ɗonno fadi haa nder luttuɓe ɓaawo.
Mi mooftii njamndi teddundi e nder paabi maɓɓe, mi fawi ɗum e huunde yaltinnde daande.
E nder ndee tagoore, miɗo hollita yonta gooto fof wonde ɓe keɓii laamɗo maɓɓe e nder ladde.
Nde gardiiɗo oo arti, mi seerti e am, mi naamnaama hol ko addani mi waɗde fenaande hono ndee.
Jukkungo am e oo aduna ko hay gooto memataa mi, ɓadtaaki mi, maande hersa nde njogiimi haa abada.

outcome.answer: Ñaawaaɗo wonde mo memotaako, haa abada wiyde ‘no contact’.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
